primary: total_fleet_travel_time_vehicle_min = sum(arrival_s - scheduled_departure_s) / 60 across every vehicle; no censoring in these runs
secondary: mean and median travel time in minutes
nearest-rank P95: sorted completed travel times at 1-based index ceil(0.95*n)
maximum dominant-route share in any 30-second decision batch
total route switches (zero by design because route is locked at P entry; rerouting mid-branch is prohibited)
seconds from incident activation to first feasible route decision
FIFO recurrence violations and event count
tie_break: Independent: Route A before B on exact estimated-cost tie. Coordinator: among equal total travel-time scores, prefer the larger A count (key=(score,-k)). Vehicle order within a batch is (P arrival timestamp, vehicle ID).
threshold_proposal_not_approved: At least 5% lower total fleet travel time than independent_periodic in primary near-capacity scenario, zero closed-link entries, zero FIFO violations, all trips complete, and no P95 degradation. Team approval required before treating as acceptance gate.
